# doit_user_notification (Resource)

Manages a personal notification of a user: the notification types the user is subscribed to, such as cost anomalies, invoices, digests and insights.

The notification is always delivered by email to the user's own address, which the API fills in as the only entry in `destinations`.

~> **Note:** Managing notifications requires the `usersManager` permission. In addition, the user the notification belongs to must hold the permission each subscribed type names, except for `cost_anomalies`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    doit = {
      source  = "doitintl/doit"
      version = "~> 1.0"
    }
  }
}

# Look up the user the notifications belong to.
data "doit_users" "jane" {
  email = "jane.doe@example.com"
}

# Notify about every cost anomaly of at least warning severity whose excess
# cost is above $100. The email goes to the user's own address.
resource "doit_user_notification" "all_anomalies" {
  user_id = data.doit_users.jane.users[0].id
  name    = "All cost anomalies"

  settings = {
    cost_anomalies = {
      min_severity    = "warning"
      min_excess_cost = { amount = "100.00", currency = "USD" }
      allocations     = { mode = "all", ids = [] }
    }
  }
}

# Only critical anomalies of specific allocations. Allocation IDs must belong
# to custom single allocations.
resource "doit_allocation" "production" {
  name        = "Production"
  description = "Production workloads"
  rule = {
    formula = "A"
    components = [
      {
        key    = "project_id"
        mode   = "is"
        type   = "fixed"
        values = ["my-production-project"]
      }
    ]
  }
}

resource "doit_user_notification" "production_critical" {
  user_id = data.doit_users.jane.users[0].id
  name    = "Critical production anomalies"

  settings = {
    cost_anomalies = {
      min_severity    = "critical"
      min_excess_cost = { amount = "1000.00", currency = "USD" }
      allocations = {
        mode = "include"
        ids  = [doit_allocation.production.id]
      }

      # Resend while the anomaly is active: every 12 hours, and whenever its
      # cost grows by 20% or by $500 within 6 hours. Remove the block to turn
      # resending off.
      repeat = {
        every_hours = 12
        when_cost_grows = {
          match            = "or"
          percent_increase = 20
          min_increase     = { amount = "500.00", currency = "USD" }
          within_hours     = 6
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

# A daily cost digest of the production allocation, plus invoice, credit and
# insight notifications. Types other than cost anomalies need the user to hold
# a permission: Cloud Analytics User for digests, Invoice Viewer for invoices
# and credit utilization, Insights Manager for insights.
resource "doit_user_notification" "billing_and_digests" {
  user_id = data.doit_users.jane.users[0].id
  name    = "Billing and daily digest"

  settings = {
    daily_digest = { allocation_ids = [doit_allocation.production.id] }

    # {} subscribes to a type without options; for invoices it means every
    # billing profile.
    new_invoices       = {}
    credit_utilization = {}

    # Only critical and high security insights on AWS.
    insights = {
      pillars    = ["security"]
      severities = ["critical", "high"]
      providers  = ["aws"]
    }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name of the notification (1–200 characters).
- `settings` (Attributes) The notification types the user is subscribed to, one attribute per type. Set at least one. For every type except `cost_anomalies`, the user must hold the permission named in its description; the API checks this on every create and update, so a user who loses a permission later cannot have the notification updated until that type is removed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings))
- `user_id` (String) The ID of the user the notification belongs to. Changing it replaces the notification.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) When the notification was created (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `destinations` (Attributes List) Server-managed destinations. Always one email entry with the target user's address. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destinations))
- `etag` (String) Current ETag of the notification. The provider sends it with updates and deletes to detect changes made outside Terraform.
- `id` (String) The ID of the notification.
- `update_time` (String) When the notification was last changed (RFC 3339, UTC).

<a id="nestedatt--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings`

Optional:

- `cloud_incidents` (Attributes) Cloud incidents. Set it to `{}` to subscribe. The user must hold the Issues Viewer permission. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--cloud_incidents))
- `cost_anomalies` (Attributes) Cloud cost anomalies. The user needs no extra permission for this type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies))
- `credit_utilization` (Attributes) Credit utilization. Set it to `{}` to subscribe. The user must hold the Invoice Viewer permission. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--credit_utilization))
- `cud_approval` (Attributes) PerfectScale for Commitments: a Google Cloud committed use discount purchase requires approval. Set it to `{}` to subscribe. The user must hold the Cloud Analytics User permission. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--cud_approval))
- `cud_purchased` (Attributes) PerfectScale for Commitments: a Google Cloud committed use discount was purchased. Set it to `{}` to subscribe. The user must hold the Cloud Analytics User permission. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--cud_purchased))
- `daily_digest` (Attributes) Daily cost digest of the listed allocations. The user must hold the Cloud Analytics User permission. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--daily_digest))
- `data_integration_sync_failure` (Attributes) Data integration sync failures. Set it to `{}` to subscribe. The user must hold the Assets Manager permission. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--data_integration_sync_failure))
- `expert_insights` (Attributes) New custom insights from the DoiT expert team. Set it to `{}` to subscribe. The user must hold the Insights Manager permission. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--expert_insights))
- `insights` (Attributes) New DoiT insights. Set it to `{}` to subscribe to every insight, or narrow it with `pillars`, `severities` and `providers`; an insight must match all three. The user must hold the Insights Manager permission. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--insights))
- `monthly_digest` (Attributes) Monthly digest. Set it to `{}` to subscribe. The user must hold the Cloud Analytics User permission. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--monthly_digest))
- `new_invoices` (Attributes) New invoices. Set it to `{}` to subscribe for every billing profile, or list `billing_profile_ids`. The user must hold the Invoice Viewer permission. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--new_invoices))
- `new_proforma_invoices` (Attributes) New proforma invoices. Set it to `{}` to subscribe for every billing profile, or list `billing_profile_ids`. The user must hold the Invoice Viewer permission. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--new_proforma_invoices))
- `new_sku_usage` (Attributes) Usage of new SKUs. Set it to `{}` to subscribe. The user must hold the Cloud Analytics User permission. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--new_sku_usage))
- `payment_reminders` (Attributes) Due or overdue payments. Set it to `{}` to subscribe for every billing profile, or list `billing_profile_ids`. The user must hold the Invoice Viewer permission. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--payment_reminders))
- `quota_utilization` (Attributes) Quota utilization. Set it to `{}` to subscribe. The user must hold the Cloud Analytics User permission. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--quota_utilization))
- `savings_plan_approval` (Attributes) PerfectScale for Commitments: an AWS Savings Plan purchase requires approval. Set it to `{}` to subscribe. The user must hold the Cloud Analytics User permission. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--savings_plan_approval))
- `savings_plan_purchased` (Attributes) PerfectScale for Commitments: an AWS Savings Plan was purchased. Set it to `{}` to subscribe. The user must hold the Cloud Analytics User permission. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--savings_plan_purchased))
- `weekly_digest` (Attributes) Weekly cost digest of the listed allocations. The user must hold the Cloud Analytics User permission. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--weekly_digest))

<a id="nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings.cost_anomalies`

Required:

- `allocations` (Attributes) Allocations whose anomalies trigger the notification. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies--allocations))
- `min_excess_cost` (Attributes) Minimum excess cost of an anomaly (not total spend) that triggers the notification. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies--min_excess_cost))
- `min_severity` (String) Minimum anomaly severity: `warning` notifies about warning and critical anomalies, `critical` only about critical ones.

Optional:

- `repeat` (Attributes) Resend controls while an anomaly is active. Set `every_hours`, `when_cost_grows`, or both; remove the block to turn resending off. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies--repeat))

<a id="nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies--allocations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings.cost_anomalies.allocations`

Required:

- `ids` (List of String) IDs of custom single allocations, kept in the configured order. Must be `[]` when `mode` is `all`, and non-empty without duplicates for `include` and `exclude`. Preset and group allocations are rejected.
- `mode` (String) `all` — every allocation with anomaly detection enabled (and unallocated anomalies). `include` — only the listed ids. `exclude` — all enabled allocations except the listed ids. `all` cannot be sent with a non-empty `ids`. `include` and `exclude` cannot be sent with an empty `ids`.
Possible values: `all`, `include`, `exclude`


<a id="nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies--min_excess_cost"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings.cost_anomalies.min_excess_cost`

Required:

- `amount` (String) Amount in whole US dollars, such as `100` or `100.00`. The API returns amounts with two decimals; state keeps the configured spelling while the value is unchanged, but an imported notification has the two-decimal spelling. Must be between `0` and `1000000000`.
- `currency` (String) Currency code. Must be `USD`.


<a id="nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies--repeat"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings.cost_anomalies.repeat`

Optional:

- `every_hours` (Number) Resend until the anomaly is inactive, every N hours (1–24).
- `when_cost_grows` (Attributes) Resend when the anomaly's cost grows. Set `percent_increase`, `min_increase`, or both. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies--repeat--when_cost_grows))

<a id="nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies--repeat--when_cost_grows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings.cost_anomalies.repeat.when_cost_grows`

Optional:

- `match` (String) How to combine `percent_increase` and `min_increase`: `or` resends when either is reached, `and` when both are. Required when both are set.
- `min_increase` (Attributes) Minimum cost increase that triggers a resend. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies--repeat--when_cost_grows--min_increase))
- `percent_increase` (Number) Minimum cost increase in percent (`10` means 10%) that triggers a resend.
- `within_hours` (Number) Only count growth within this many hours (1–24). Omit it to turn the time window off.

<a id="nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies--repeat--when_cost_grows--min_increase"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings.cost_anomalies.repeat.when_cost_grows.min_increase`

Required:

- `amount` (String) Amount in whole US dollars, such as `100` or `100.00`. The API returns amounts with two decimals; state keeps the configured spelling while the value is unchanged, but an imported notification has the two-decimal spelling. Must be between `1` and `1000000000`.
- `currency` (String) Currency code. Must be `USD`.

<a id="nestedatt--settings--insights"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings.insights`

Optional:

- `pillars` (List of String) Insight pillars to notify about: `cost`, `operations`, `performance`, `security` or `compliance`. Omit it or set `[]` for every pillar.
- `providers` (List of String) Insights provider IDs to notify about, such as `aws`, `gcp`, `azure`, `k8s` or `google-workspace` (not invoice platform IDs such as `amazon-web-services`). Omit it or set `[]` for every provider.
- `severities` (List of String) Insight severities to notify about: `critical`, `high`, `medium` or `low`. Omit it or set `[]` for every severity.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--destinations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `destinations`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String) Target user's email, copied by the server.
- `type` (String) Delivery channel. Personal delivery is email only.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import using the composite ID: user_id/notification_id.
terraform import doit_user_notification.example [user_id]/[notification_id]
```
